title: spergularia rubra subsp. nicaeensis
intro: Spergularia rubra subsp. nicaeensis, commonly known as Red Sandwort, is a type of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its potential to help with digestive issues, such as dyspepsia, and its antioxidant properties to prevent cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Red Sandwort include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
